top_choice_rationale: Base editing meets my game-changer standard: a deaminase directed to one nucleotide gives a new chemical outcome in the genome without a double-strand break, with an evolved adenine deaminase, wide independent reproduction and clinical use already. Liu alone is the cleanest attribution, as he conceived and directed both editor programmes, and it leaves no three-person boundary to defend. P001 follows because it adds the best-validated C-N coupling at the cost of an uneven pairing; P002 and P003 come next, with no award last.
